title: Rav Chanina bar Avdimi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Nedarim 61b and Kiddushin 64b: “Rav Chanina bar Avdimi said that Rav said: the attribution is reversed.” In Bava Kamma 96b he reports Rav as saying: “The halakhah follows Rabbi Meir,” and it is asked: “Would Rav abandon the Rabbis and act like Rabbi Meir?” They answered: because the baraita teaches it the reverse way.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Nedarim 61b and Kiddushin 64b fully write Rabbi Chanina bar Avdimi, whereas Bava Kamma 96b fully writes Rav. Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav. In Bava Kamma the halakhah statement is reported from Rav; the quoted reversal and question are kept with their original force.
